children: Stablecorp said QCAD, a Canadian dollar stablecoin, is now live on Arc and integrated with Circle’s StableFX, enabling 24/7 onchain PvP settlement for CAD against supported stablecoins.
Expands QCAD reach onto an EVM L1 aimed at finance, potentially boosting adoption and liquidity.
Enables institutional-grade RFQ and PvP settlement, making CAD stablecoin FX executable 24/7.
Compresses settlement time from days to minutes, a draw for treasury and payments flows.
Broader pair coverage can drive volumes if counterparties onboard to StableFX.
Reduces principal risk versus traditional sequential settlement; improves institutional appeal.

This is an early-stage product expansion positioning QCAD within emerging onchain FX and settlement rails. A catalyst would be disclosed institutional adoption, volumes, or revenue tied to QCAD usage on Arc/StableFX.
